pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft piano intro, quiet night atmosphere)

The street is still
before the song begins
somewhere in the dark
a small light waits

[Verse 1]
Walking through a silent night
the pavement holds your name
every step I take
returns to you again

Cold wind moves slowly
through the empty road
and somewhere in that breath
your memory appears

[Chorus]
When I touch your light
the night becomes softer
even from far away
it reaches my chest

Your quiet smile
rests inside my day
and somewhere in that warmth
I begin again

[Verse 2]
Rain across the window
and a sky without a star
I used to stand there
watching nothing move

But one small voice
stayed inside the storm
and like a hidden flower
something slowly grew

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
Some nights are longer
than the fading streetlights
a sky without a single star

But I remember softly
what you once told me
“I will be your star”

And that quiet sentence
still holds my steps

[Chorus]
When I reach your hand
the night feels different
two quiet shadows
walking side by side

Your light once found me
in my darkest hour
now I carry
a small light too

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, delicate fading piano)

The road is still dark
but our steps continue
somewhere in the night
two lights remain
